title: lilium croceum var. bulbiferum
intro: Lilium croceum var. bulbiferum, commonly known as the Tiger Lily, is a species of flowering plant in the lily family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in reducing pain and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Lilium croceum var. bulbiferum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immune-modulating effects. The plant's therapeutic actions may also include analgesic, antiseptic, and anti-cancer properties, making it a subject of interest in modern medicine.
